title: Phone calls
description: The phone call capability, contract call/1. Apps that place calls declare uses call/1#dial on an action; a tenant administrator binds an implementation in Admin → Capabilities. Until then the entry stays hidden.

body.name: call
body.title: Phone calls
body.description: Place an outbound phone call. The implementation answers with its own ID for the call.

actions.name: dial
actions.title: Dial
actions.description: Place a call to a phone number.

tests.name: dials
tests.title: Places a call and answers with its call ID
